# Hold Fix for Sensors Already On

A fix for holds whose sensors were already detecting motion when the hold started.

### Fixed
- **Hold now runs after a restart or reload.** If a motion sensor was already on when Home Assistant started, or when a sensor joined a room hold, the hold could drop straight to clear once that sensor cleared, instead of holding for the hold time. These sensors now count as detected from that moment.

### Upgrade notes
- No configuration changes are needed.
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/Hold-Latch/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.1
